parameters.name: cascade
parameters.description: The subnet will be deleted from the Global Router service along with static routes that use subnet IP addresses as next hops.  If the subnet is in the `vpc` service, it will also be deleted from the cloud platform.

parameters.name: disconnect
parameters.description: The subnet will be deleted from the Global Router service along with static routes that use subnet IP addresses as next hops.  The subnet will not be deleted from its source service.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Sets language for error responses. Can be 'ru' or 'en'.

parameters.name: X-Request-ID
parameters.description: Sets req-id for request. Must be a valid UUID v4 string. If not provided, will be generated automatically.

400.description: Bad request. Fix the request and try again.

401.description: Bad or expired token. You can reissue a token and try again.

403.description: Access is forbidden. Make sure you have the required permissions.

500.description: An internal server error occured. Try again later.

request.scope: Account IAM; immutable account scope. AttachVPC origin must be service network, SDK generation v2 (Neutron2.0), selected network/subnet kind, same account, explicit nonempty project/region/pool, compatible location and exact validated endpoint. Source ancestor refs preserve service/generation/endpoint identity. Reject before credential lookup or HTTP; retain validated original ref separately.
request.identity: Existing Global Router resources addressed by exact typed refs. Creates for network/subnet/route require selected router/zone/network refs and reject conflicting body IDs.
request.body: All properties of generated source DTO; nil omitted, explicit empty strings/arrays preserved, protected fields revealed only at HTTP boundary. PUT uses published replacement endpoint; no PATCH inference. Native AttachVPC uses pinned supplemental DTO with original project_id and os_network_id/os_subnet_id.
request.query: All published parameters: typed current page/limit/sort/filter, router nested, directory show_groups/show_zones, explicit cascade/disconnect. No invented completion marker.
request.headers: Immutable WithHeaders view supports only documented Accept-Language ru/en and UUID-v4 X-Request-ID; authentication remains core-owned.
request.native_sdk_variants: POST networks/subnets additionally has native VPC and dedicated source shapes. Current DTO represents VLAN/inner VLAN/VDC/current source IDs. AttachVPC pins original service ref and native project_id fields absent from current schema. Supplemental evidence: catalog/evidence/global-router-sdk-models.json.

response.field_mapping: All published properties, including nested router/network/subnet/route and prefix_pool/directory structures. Optional pointers preserve omission; arbitrary-precision Integer counts/VLAN/VPN/quota; RFC3339 timestamps normalize UTC; response ref fields ignored.
response.resource_ref: Account-scoped Global Router refs only for explicit IDs, exact endpoint and generation. Network/router, subnet/network and nested route parents retain confirmed same-service identities. Returned account and ancestor IDs checked. Source OS/service IDs remain typed metadata. AttachVPC checks returned project/source/zone identities before new ID adoption and retains original supplied source ref separately in Receipt, without changing its scope. Mutation identity validation checks every available returned router_id/network_id/subnet_id against the exact selected ancestor chain before any new ref adoption; nested static-route subnet parent is not compared with router_id.

errors.404: not_found for reads; documented mutation rejection
errors.transport_loss: unknown_outcome after possible transmission; retain exact input refs
errors.malformed_accepted_response: protocol_error with accepted Receipt and trustworthy ID extracted before later DTO decoding
errors.message: Fixed SDK message; provider error body discarded

retry: Bounded safe reads; mutations one attempt, never replay

wait.availability: No automated wait binding; exact Get returns raw published ACTIVE/ERROR/IMMUTABLE/CREATING/UPDATING/DELETING status without readiness inference

recovery.availability: Exact Get observation only; no root Resume, name lookup, adoption or authorship inference

timeout: CallTimeout and MaxJSONBytes bound every page/response
destructive_semantics: Explicit cascade may also delete original VPC network/subnet resources. Explicit disconnect preserves source resources. No implicit flags are selected; provider defaults remain provider-owned.
